project.title: Gut microbiome of shorebird Red-necked Stint
project.description: This data encompasses the 16S amplicon data (V1-V3 region) used in the article "Gut microbiota of long-distance migrant demonstrates resistance against environmental microbe incursions". It includes samples collected from birds, as well as some environmental samples from foraging areas, and negative controls.

samples: Metagenome or environmental sample from indoor metagenome
environmental sample; urban association not established
